hook.name: VolatilityDynamicFeeLimitOrderHook
hook.description: Unilaunch singleton hook that implements volatility-responsive dynamic LP fees: applies a base fee plus a surge multiplier when large tick movements are detected in afterSwap, decaying it over a configurable duration. Blocks trading for one block after pool initialization as an anti-sandwich measure. Integrates with an external limit order manager for limit order execution.
